proposal.title: Ratification and implementation of Terra Governance Proposal 4855
proposal.description:
Conditional on Proposal 4855 passing Terra Governance, the Stewardship Multisig approves:

- The nomination and election process for a fifth independent director.
- Treasury payment of the required governance deposits for registered election ballots, with refunded Treasury-funded deposits returned to the Treasury.
- Appointment of the selected eligible candidate following required onboarding, with five equally weighted members and at least three affirmative approvals required for multisig execution.
- The exact bylaw additions specified in Proposal 4855, incorporated by reference without alteration, for adoption under §7.3.

Implementation must follow Proposal 4855 and the Foundation’s applicable governing documents, approval and veto requirements. Membership and voting-configuration changes must be tested before execution. An immutable copy of Proposal 4855 must be preserved with the adoption record.

This resolution does not itself transfer funds, appoint a director or change multisig settings. Those actions require their corresponding approvals and execution. The bylaw amendment becomes effective only when its adoption requirements are completed.

If Proposal 4855 does not pass, these approvals do not take effect.
